convert_eqv2_to_hydra: run the eqv2 to hydra conversion script to convert an equiformer v2 checkpoint and config to hydra format
convert_checkpoint_and_config: run the convert_checkpoint_and_config_to_hydra function to transform an eqv2 checkpoint and yaml config into hydra equivalents
run_eqv2_conversion_cli: run the eqv2_to_hydra_eqv2 cli script with checkpoint and yaml paths to output hydra format files
parse_eqv2_conversion_args: run the argparse cli to parse eqv2 checkpoint path, eqv2 yaml path, and hydra output paths for conversion
output_hydra_eqv2_files: run the conversion script to output a hydra eqv2 checkpoint and hydra eqv2 yaml config from eqv2 inputs
